notes: Use separate CARGO_TARGET_DIR values for each checkout; shared build-script caches can invalidate this comparison.
macOS build enables fast-apple-datapath. Windows target is MSVC, Linux is GNU.
No trait objects or per-packet allocations introduced. Native API function pointers on Windows/Apple are preserved.
Windows receive and try_send instructions match after normalizing crate hashes, local label numbering and constant-data symbols.
Linux functions are not byte-identical: compiler inlining and symbol linkage differ. recv still directly contains recvmmsg; no receive policy state is stored.
macOS recv entry frame changes from 9168 to 48 bytes. These are entry frames, excluding callees, not total stack use or measured throughput.
